adjustments.title: Written async standup
adjustments.how_to_ask: Ask your manager if you can post your standup in Slack before the call.

adjustments.title: Written acceptance criteria on every ticket
adjustments.how_to_ask: Ask that tickets assigned to you include acceptance criteria.

letter:
Hi Ana,

To work at my best I'd like to propose two changes:
1. Posting my standup in writing before the call.
2. Written acceptance criteria on my tickets.

Both are free to set up. Happy to talk about it.

Andrei
